description: An arced strip of image cards wrapped around an invisible cylinder: it turns with drag or mouse wheel, fades at both edges, and picks up a subtle wave during a fast spin. Clicking a card opens it — it scales up, its description appears, and the rest dim and lose their color.
interactionNotes: Drag or spin with the mouse wheel — motion is inertial and snaps to the nearest card when it stops. The arrows and PageUp/PageDown step card by card, and Home/End jump to the two ends. Clicking a card opens it (a second click or Escape closes it), and hover lifts the card slightly.

props.items: The gallery images; `text` is the label under the card, `description` is the copy in the open state, and `alt` is the alternative text. Images are center-cropped, so an aspect ratio close to the card's gives the cleanest result.
props.bend: Depth of the rail's arc; zero means a flat row. Negative bends the arc the other way.
props.textColor: Color of the labels, the keyboard focus ring, and the placeholder for an image that is loading.
props.borderRadius: Corner rounding of the cards relative to their shorter side (0 to 0.5).
props.font: Label font as a full CSS shorthand. If it stays at the default, the typeface loads from Google Fonts; for Persian, pass your own font.
props.fontUrl: URL of a custom font file or stylesheet; if you pass one, the default fetch is skipped and the family comes from here instead.
props.scrollSpeed: Response multiplier for dragging and the mouse wheel.
props.scrollEase: Springiness of the target chase (0.001 to 1); lower is softer and slower.
props.itemSize: Card size multiplier relative to the scene height (0.2 to 2).
props.itemAspect: Width-to-height ratio of the cards; below 1 they become more vertical.
props.gap: Spacing between cards relative to card width.
props.wave: Surface wave that travels across the cards during a fast spin; zero means no wave.
props.fadeEdges: Width of the fade at both scene edges relative to the width (0 to 0.5); zero means a hard cut.
props.shadow: Strength of the soft shadow under the cards; zero means no shadow.
props.grayscale: Keep inactive cards black and white and color them on hover or activation.
props.showTitles: Show the label under the cards.
props.snap: After release, snap to the nearest card and activate it.
props.autoScroll: Gentle automatic drift after 1.8 seconds of stillness; it stops on hover, drag, an open card, or keyboard focus.
props.openOnClick: A click on a card opens it; turn it off so a click only activates the card.
props.intro: Staggered entrance animation of the cards on first render.
props.onItemClick: Called when any card is clicked (before it opens).
props.onActiveChange: Called when the active card changes (rotation, snap, or keyboard).
props.dpr: Render pixel ratio; it defaults to the device's and is capped at 2.

tips: Zero dependencies: the engine is raw WebGL2 — a texture atlas of all the images is built once and each card is drawn with a single draw call.
If WebGL2 is unavailable the scene stays silent — that is the default behavior too; the accessibility labels for the keyboard are always there.
For a 'display row' gallery set `itemAspect` below 1 and `gap` high; for a wide grid, `itemAspect` above 1 with a low `bend`.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the intro becomes instant, the wave and drift are off, and snapping happens immediately; manual dragging is untouched.
The component's default font (Figtree) comes from Google Fonts; for Persian, pass your own font to `font` so no external request is made.
